methods.broad: 1024-point periodic Hann, 256 hop, centred explicit zeros, 17-bin/time median HPSS squared soft masks, shared stereo magnitude
methods.guided: four chronological cue means, eight chronological mixture means multiplied by squared complement of normalized cue mean spectrum; fixed L1 W; all-one H; 25 Euclidean multiplicative updates; squared Wiener mask; no seed, labels, truth or fitted shift

component_routing: fixed harmonic for broad; extracted for guided; no extra stem ranking or best-stem choice
candidate_diagnostic: first case only, all sixteen original candidate passages; original-query/processed-candidate and paired processed-query/processed-candidate, same 0..57600 support; every cue/candidate pair charged
stop_rule: one batch; retain failures/abstentions and all costs; no replacement cases/settings after scores
candidate_rule: unchanged EfficientAT MN04, original complete A04 passages, 384-float cosine; mean per unique example; stable score/asset/start/end ties; pitch off; K=1/5/10

metrics.retrieval: source hit@K and exact asset event recovery@K on native full-render intervals, paired gains/losses, abstentions; controls separate
metrics.preservation: aligned exact inserted float32 component, gain-inclusive SDR/improvement, SI-SDR, target/background projections, first25ms attack/final200ms tail projections, clipping, zero native delay; no correction applied

promotion.retrieval: at least two additional primary top1 cases, zero paired top1 losses and no hit10 decrease; complete primary batch
promotion.preservation: each primary attack and tail projection in [0.8,1.25], no overload, median gain-inclusive SDR improvement at least 1dB
promotion.cost: each 3.5s primary processing unit <=10 CPU wall seconds; fixed per-unit allocation under128MiB, no downloads; real evidence also complete
promotion.otherwise: original stays default; experimental modes remain opt-in; oracle never eligible

geometry_note: native float32 target multiplication precedes common float64 gain; independently checked to <=2e-8 absolute plus1e-7 relative, saved exact inserted component is waveform truth
evidence_scope: inspected A04/B01 development families reused in separately generated mixtures; no untouched holdout or human agreement
